evidence.note: choosing and saving both pass disabled with status Some; idle is the only status None and always sets disabled=false. disabled=true with status None is never constructed. failed keeps disabled=false with status Some, so this is implication, not E3 presence duplication.

notes: Projection of VaultSelectionState idle|choosing|saving|failed onto a disabled bit plus optional status message. legal: enabled-none (idle), disabled-some (choosing/saving), enabled-some (failed).
